systems.name: Puget Sound Emergency Radio Network PSERN Full
systems.description:
Full feed for the Puget Sound Emergency Radio Network PSERN. Covers Seattle, Redmond, Kirkland, Bellevue, Renton, Bothell, Federal Way, Tukwilla, and the rest of King County. Portions of surrounding counties may also have some coverage.

PSERN is a P25 digital network that replaces the analog King County Emergency Response Service. KCERS was fully decommissioned in August, 2023.

This feed is very busy, often recording hundreds or thousands of calls an hour during peak times. This can make it nearly impossible to follow without filter groups. If you want a filter group created for an area of interest, use the Message button to contact me and provide the details about the group you would like to see.

Hardware recently updated in to improve call quality, reduce dropped calls, and increase uptime.
